name: annotate-skill
description: Annotate: a self-contained, Tufte-styled HTML review surface for marking up markdown documents with inline suggestions, comments, and deletions.

plugins.name: annotate
plugins.description: Turn any markdown file into a browser annotation surface. Select text to leave Suggest / Comment / Delete notes that anchor as margin sidenotes, then export structured markdown an AI can apply. No build step, no server, no dependencies beyond Python 3.
